quote.text: Art is so big, so unfathomable, that it teaches us to mourn for strangers.
You don't wish for happiness when you have lost the love of your life, because you can't even imagine ever feeling happy again. All you wish for is peace, calm, a long night sleep.
No one tells you when you're young that when you are middle-aged, you can't cry attractively anymore, the slightest little emotin can make you look like you've fallen through ice.
Only someone who still has all their people left wants to stop time.
We never get that age back again, when every friend is a childhood friend, we measure all infatuations throughout our lives against that.
Which will hold greater rule over you? Your fear or your curiosity?
"Is it horrible being an adult?" the girl asked. "Unbearable." the mother replied. "You fail with almost everything, all the time."
"Don't be ashamed to be a human being - be proud! Inside you one vault after another opens endlessly. You'll never be complete, and that's as it should be." - Tomas Transtromer
